(Shaurya Malwa/CoinDesk) Summary * Anonymous Cat, a Solana memecoin known as ZCAT, has distributed about 2,320 zcash tokens worth roughly $2.8 million to eligible holders through a 3 percent transfer tax. * ZCAT reached a market value of about $124 million as zcash surged more than 2,300 percent over the past year amid renewed demand for privacy-focused cryptocurrencies. * The rewards depend on continued ZCAT trading rather than income from a business or investment, meaning payouts could fall sharply if activity and liquidity decline. A cat memecoin on Solana has paid its holders nearly $3 million worth of zcash as a rally in both tokens turned an unusual reward mechanism into a substantial payout. Anonymous Cat, or ZCAT, charges a 3% tax whenever the token is transferred. Most of that money is converted into zcash (ZEC) and distributed to wallets holding at least $20 worth of ZCAT, according to the project's dashboard. ZCAT itself trades against ZEC through StonkFun, a Solana launchpad that lets newly created tokens use assets other than SOL or stablecoins as their trading pair. About 2,320 ZEC, worth roughly $2.8 million as of Asian morning hours Monday, has been distributed across more than 470,000 payouts, the data show. ZCAT has surged alongside it.
